headline: This change fixes spelling and wording on the home and pricing pages and changes the sign-up button text to say free trial.
what_changed: The home page and pricing page now use the words "Start your free trial" on their sign-up buttons, instead of "Get started free".
The Starter plan, which costs $0, now also shows a "Start your free trial" button, which is a slightly odd fit for a plan that is free anyway.
Typos are fixed: "patern", "attachements", "hobbiests", "trail" and "organised" wording was tidied, and "scans" became "scanned pages".
No prices, plan features, seat counts or sign-up links were changed.

risks.title: Free trial wording on every sign-up button is not verified here
risks.explanation: The pricing page already said all plans include a 14-day free trial, and this change repeats that promise on every sign-up button, including the paid Studio and Guild plans. This review has no sign-up or billing code in the project, so I could not confirm that paid plans really start with a trial. If they do not, some customers could be misled about whether they will be charged. Ask the developer to confirm the trial works on every plan before the wording goes live.

questions_for_developer: Does the sign-up flow give a 14-day free trial on the Studio and Guild plans, and is the customer not charged until the trial ends?
Is "Start your free trial" meant for the free Starter plan too, or should that button keep wording like "Get started free"?
good_news: The change is small and only touches wording, so the risk of breaking the site is very low.
No prices, plan features or links were changed, so customer costs stay the same.
